content:
2026年8月27日更新：The new Mac Studio is now available for pre-order on Amazon.

Apple today announced several major updates for the Mac, including brand-new Mac Studio and Mac mini lineups.

If you're looking to pick up any of Apple's newly announced products, you can now pre-order them on Amazon.

What's new today?

For the full breakdown of the latest Mac Studio and Mac mini updates, check out our dedicated coverage. The new machines feature all-new chips (M6 and M5 Ultra) with improved performance, a range of new configuration options, and a heavy dose of AI optimizations.

  • Apple unveils new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro chips
  • Apple unveils new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
  • Apple announces next-gen Apple Silicon chips: M6 and M5 Ultra

Buy at Amazon

Following this morning's announcement, Amazon is now accepting orders for the new Mac mini and a selection of new accessories.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB — $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB — $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB — $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB — $1,699
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/412GB — $2,499

Apple has also made a few small changes to the Magic Keyboard, and the new models are now available on Amazon:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard — $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID — $149
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad (Black) — $199

And of course, there's the brand-new Apple Polishing Cloth at $9, down from the original's $19.

  • Apple Polishing Cloth — $9

Buy at Best Buy

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB — $1,599
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB — $2,499

Are you planning to pick up any of Apple's latest releases? Let us know in the comments.
